name: Dobby the Fat
languages: Sylvan (occasionally — one word per long rest, source unknown)
proficiencies: Keen Smell (Advantage on Perception checks involving scent)
backstory: Dobby the Fat is a tiny dachshund of immense character and questionable intellect. His belly drags slightly on the grass, he is built like a sturdy bratwurst, and he knows exactly one command — "sit" — but only if ham is involved. He has somehow survived multiple encounters with passing carts, wagons, and at least one confused goat.
personality: Manipulative puppy eyes that could disarm a dragon. Will absolutely betray the party for sausages. Naps aggressively.
ideals: Food. All food. The concept of food. The memory of food.
bonds: Pet Owner: Wood Elf Fighter. Dobby tolerates them in exchange for regular meals and belly rubs.
flaws: Knows 'sit' only if there is ham. Prone (literally) after any cart accident. Has been known to store mysterious items in his neck crease.
appearance: Tiny dachshund. Size: Tiny. Belly nearly grazes the ground. Low center of gravity, limited ground clearance. Neck crease of unusual depth and capacity.
features:
Calamity Magnet: Upon entering any new town or village, the DM rolls a d20. On a 1, Dobby is accidentally struck by a passing cart, wagon, or coach — takes 1d4 bludgeoning damage and is Prone until his owner uses an action to pick him up.

The Infinite Crease (Weird Feature): Dobby has a skin fold near his neck that functions like a Bag of Holding, but only for small, organic items. He can store up to 1 lb of food (sausages, acorns, or cheese) inside his rolls. Retrieving an item requires a DC 10 Sleight of Hand check or the retriever is covered in dog drool.

Dreamwalker Pup: During long rests, Dobby kicks his legs as if chasing celestial squirrels, whimpers at unseen cosmic mailmen, and occasionally speaks a single word in Sylvan. Nobody knows why.
equipment:
His own body (Tiny, formidable)
Neck crease (Bag of Holding, food only, 1 lb capacity)
notes:
- Senses: Passive Perception 14, Keen Smell
- Natural Armor (AC 10)
- STR -2: belly drags slightly on the grass
- DEX +0: low center of gravity, limited ground clearance
- CON +3: built like a sturdy bratwurst
- INT -1: knows 'sit' (if there is ham)
- WIS +2: can hear a cheese wrapper from 300 yards
- CHA +3: manipulative puppy eyes
relationships: Wood Elf Fighter — Pet owner. Provides food, belly rubs, and emergency pickup after cart accidents.
